name: @red-cup-engineering/witness-journal-invocation-service
description: Witnesses one scripted invocation (caller, verb, args, action, value, time) into the caller's dated witness journal, best-effort and never throwing. Extracted from relating's services/invocation-ledger, which fused this namespace/date-path law to the generic entry and log laws now owned by witness-journal-entry-service and witness-journal-log-service.
